action.command:
cd /workspace
export GITHUB_TOKEN="ghp_dummytesttoken0000000000000000000000"
export JAVA_HOME=/usr/lib/jvm/java-21-openjdk-amd64; export PATH="$JAVA_HOME/bin:$PATH"
rm -f /tmp/serve-boards.log
setsid nohup just serve --apps=boards < /dev/zero > /tmp/serve-boards.log 2>&1 &
echo "boards serve pid $!"
sleep 15; tail -2 /tmp/serve-boards.log; free -m | sed -n '2p'
